summary: Vintage Scientific Papers with LaTeX is a collection of LaTeX templates and resources for publishing scientific papers. It is delivered as a PowerShell‑based CLI tool that can invoke pdflatex and also works with GUI editors. It is aimed at authors who need ready‑made paper styles and want a local alternative to cloud editors. While benchmarks show extremely fast import times, the project is brand‑new, has limited community traction, and its installation fails, making it a niche option.

github.description: Twenty LuaLaTeX and MetaPost (fiziko) examples of the old scientific-paper aesthetic: engraved plates, star charts, computed log tables, knots, telescopes
